usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear, well-corroborated picture: Michelle Gass, CEO of Levi Strauss & Co. since January 2024 (joined 2023 as president), previously Kohl's CEO and ~17 years at Starbucks after P&G, with her current strategy ($10B by 2030, women's business 40%→50%, premium Blue Tab launch, DTC/denim-first transformation), recent results (7% organic growth to $6.2B, Dockers divestiture), PepsiCo board seat, and honors. Multiple independent sources (WWD, Business Wire, Retail Dive, Wikipedia, Vogue, CNBC) converge on the core identity and role, so a reader learns who she is and what she has done. The dossier does flag contested/claimed statuses, which partially signals uncertainty, but it never explicitly states what it does not know — e.g., whether the RILA/NRF board seats and the '35 years of experience' and honors claims are still current, and it offers no gaps section — so it slightly implies more completeness than it has. For meeting prep it is strong: current role, strategy priorities, recent launches and financials, and board affiliations are all present and dated.
